content.title: Celestial Drive
about: Celestial Drive is a personal rail-shooter prototype inspired by the Gummi Ship segments from Kingdom Hearts.
The project focuses on building the feel of on-rails movement, shooting, and basic progression systems.
It is an unreleased prototype used to explore ideas and iterate on core mechanics.
features: On-rails movement prototype with forward progression
Prototype-level iteration focused on feel and readability
learnings: Prototyping movement and camera in a rail-shooter context
